song_craft: Voice: hammer couplets (Siddhitrayī proof-voice, same as ajad). Arc: auspice-that-sings (v1) → thesis (v2) → three refusals (vv3–5: awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness — each needing a consciousness it denies) → enemy staged (v6) → retorsion (vv7–8: unwardable shining-clinging; error as shining astray) → warrant (v9). Sthāyin utsāha: exultation as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text testifies against itself. L3 tight incl. nominal mirrors: L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: With relation whose self is difference-and-non-difference, proving all things —
whose work is world-traffic — him, Śiva, of own will we sing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhedābhedātmasaṃbandhasahasarvārthasādhitā lokayātrā kṛtiryasya svecchayā taṃ stumaḥ śivam

verses.craft: Auspice that performs itself: of-own-will we sing — the verse does what it says; svecchayā agency held open per BOUNDARY (read as his).
verses.rejected: (a) praise for sing → killed: stumaḥ performs; praise would describe. (b) resolving his/our will → killed by BOUNDARY held-open.

lines: Dawning in a body built of relation — being, difference, and the rest —
one, yet conquering: world-self, light, supreme Lord.

verses.craft: Thesis in dawning-body; participial setup line 1, spine line 2 (L3 note); kha variant logged not sung.

lines: Awaiting, dependence — no relation for the two inert ones:
ruled out. Win selfhood or not — metaphor, never definition.

verses.craft: Refusal hammer; nominal both lines (verbless SA); metaphor-never-definition guillotine close.
verses.rejected: (a) verbs for nominals → killed by SA mirror. (b) softening ruled-out → killed: refusal is total.

lines: None barred from the many in one's own oneness — so others plead:

lines: So even in this shining, the many's unity-seeing finds warrant —
statable too, told plain on recognition's path.
